environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running the gRPC token service as a Deployment with 1 replica, 50 worker threads. Pod has network policy allowing ingress from any pod in the namespace. HSM is a SoftHSM2 instance running as a sidecar container. No rate limiting on the gRPC endpoint. Service exposed via internal ClusterIP. Clients can issue concurrent Transfer RPCs with the same nonce before the first completes, exploiting the TOCTOU window during HSM signing latency.
